preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 10000, inclusive.
The number of spaceships and bases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The cost of having a base attacked and the cost of creating a dummy base is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x <= n for all x in spaceship and base locations
preconditions.description: The location of each spaceship and base is a valid node index within the range of the graph nodes.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= a, f, d <= 10^9 for all a, f, d in spaceship and base attributes
preconditions.description: The attack strength, fuel for spaceships, and defense strength for bases are between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer representing the minimum gold the rebels can lose.

invariants.expression: Each spaceship can attack at most one base and each base can be attacked by at most one spaceship.
invariants.description: The assignment of spaceships to bases is constrained as per the problem statement.

invariants.expression: The minimum cost is determined by the optimal assignment of spaceships to bases, considering the cost of creating dummy bases.
invariants.description: The calculation of the minimum cost involves finding the optimal strategy for attacking bases with spaceships and creating dummy bases to minimize gold loss.
